heading: Today
text: Areas of low clouds and patchy fog giving way to increasing sunshine.  More clouds and a few stray showers in NH.  Highs in the 70s to low 80s.  Winds light and variable.

heading: Tonight
text: Partly cloudy, with some areas of fog developing.  Lows in the 50s to near 60.  Winds light and variable.

heading: Wednesday
text: Morning sun, then clouds increasing and lowering west to east.  Showers developing in the St. Lawrence Valley late morning, spreading east through northern areas during the afternoon.  Highs in the 70s to low 80s.  Light winds, becoming south 5 to 15 mph from the Green Mountains west.
